title: Raw <table>/<form>/<input>/<select>/<textarea> in project code
why: @karni/ui ships these as schema-driven components (sorting, pagination, validation, accessibility). Rebuilding them per page is the boilerplate Karni exists to remove, and the copies drift.
fix: Compose the component the message names: ResourceTable for <table>, ResourceForm for <form>, Input / Select / ResourceSelect / Textarea for fields (ResourceForm renders the right field for you). Opt out only with `// eslint-disable-next-line karni/no-raw-elements -- <reason>`.

title: A page file is longer than its cap (50 lines by default)
why: Pages compose @karni/ui components; a long page is rebuilding something Karni ships.
fix: Compose Page / ResourceTable / ResourceForm / ResourceDetail and their props, or move logic into hooks and components. Opt out only with `/* eslint-disable karni/max-page-lines -- <reason> */`.

title: An import reaches into @karni/ui internals
why: Only the package root is public API (docs/stability.md); internals change without notice, and a vendored copy forks the component.
fix: Import from "@karni/ui" and compose or extend the exported component. Opt out only with `// eslint-disable-next-line karni/no-deep-imports -- <reason>`.

title: fetch / axios / XMLHttpRequest / WebSocket outside the api client
why: The generated typed hooks and KarniClient handle auth, errors, retries and types in one place; ad-hoc HTTP calls bypass all of it.
fix: Use the generated typed hooks (useResourceList / useResourceItem / useResourceMutations) or createKarniClient from @karni/ui; keep transports under the api/ directory. Opt out only with `// eslint-disable-next-line karni/no-direct-http -- <reason>`.
